name: RAYE
bio: Rachel Agatha Keen, known professionally as RAYE, is a British singer and songwriter. She is known for blending pop, R&B, soul and jazz. She began her career as a songwriter and gained recognition through collaborations and hit singles such as "You Don't Know Me", "Secrets" and "Prada". Her debut studio album, My 21st Century Blues (2023), reached No. 2 on the UK Albums Chart and featured the global hit "Escapism." with 070 Shake. The album received widespread critical acclaim and earned her six BRIT Awards in 2024, including Album of the Year and Artist of the Year, making her the most-awarded artist in a single BRIT Awards ceremony. Her second studio album, THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE. (2026), debuted at No. 1 in the UK and won the prestigious Mercury Prize. The album also earned her 11 nominations at the 2027 Grammy Awards, including Album of the Year, Record of the Year and Song of the Year, bringing her career total to 15 Grammy nominations.
